channel.title: KiwiDesk
channel.description: Updates for KiwiDesk, a tiling window manager for macOS.

item.description:
KiwiDesk can keep itself up to date now.

Updates

  • New versions arrive on their own. KiwiDesk checks quietly in the background and tells you when there is something newer, so you no longer have to go looking for it. Nothing installs without you saying yes.
  • Ask whenever you like. There is a Check for Updates… item in the menu for when you would rather not wait to be told.
  • See what changed before you take it. The update window shows you the notes for the new version, and the same notes now live on the KiwiDesk site.

If you installed with Homebrew, do this once

  • Run brew upgrade --cask kiwidesk to move onto this version. After that KiwiDesk keeps itself current and Homebrew steps aside for it — which also means a plain brew upgrade will pass KiwiDesk by from now on. Naming the cask still works whenever you want Homebrew to do it instead.
